nom: Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Anti-Aging Eye Cream Balm with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: This eye balm treatment works wonderful with the Revilizaing supreme plus line of products.

Really disappointed in this eye cream, especially for the price. I've been using it 1-2 times/day for well over a month now and it hasn't made any difference in my fine lines or dark circles at all. It isn't even really moisturizing.

I would love to recommend this product, but the last few times I've purchased, the jar is over half empty. I am now seeing others complain about this as well. There are completely empty pockets and one side of the jar is totally hollow. I cant afford this eye cream at this rate. Something needs to be done about the packaging process. Otherwise, the eye cream itself is quite luxurious.

I couldn't believe it because this actually helped the dark circles under my eyes. Mine are really dark, and I have been trying to minimize them. I only received a small trial but this has made a difference so I plan to buy it to see if continued use will make a difference. I received this free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
Wonderful product. Cleared dry patch that even the dermatologist and prescription medication couldn't do.

When I opened the product and went to use it, there was a huge air pocket. When I tapped the bottle on the counter, the air bubble went away and I was left with a container that was almost empty. Waste of money. Very disappointed.

I was looking for something to brighten my under eye area. Ive been using Estēe Lauder for a while now, but I'd never tried the eye creams or gels because of the reviews. I figured since this was a different eye cream than the ones showing bad reviews I'd give it a try. As soon as I put it under my eye, it immediately started to burn. I washed it all off and put a cook towel on my face to try to calm it down. I don't know what ingredient you guys are using in the eye creams, but at some point you need to start taking the feedback seriously. This is dangerous.

avis.titre: Made an account to write this review
avis.texte: This actually worked to reduce my dark circles! After about two weeks, my dark circles were reduced by a lot. The puffiness of my eyes was also reduced, but not as much as the dark circles. This cream also has good hydration. It is a little tinted, so it helps reduce dark circles in that way, too. I evaluated whether it reduced the circles before I reapplied, so it's not just the tint that made me think it reduced them, don't worry.
Just started using this product. Love Love. I saw a difference immediately. Great moisture. Great friend to my skin.

Got this as a sample size. This goes on so smooth and has this beautiful very light shimmer to it. I thought it was just the sunlight, so I just applied to one side and really saw the difference once applied. Instantly brightens the area around my eyes.
I use this eye cream 2 times a week along with my advanced night repair synchronized eye gel.

avis.titre: Works well…if the jar is full.
avis.texte: I've been using only EL products for 25 years. My skin always looks great.This eye cream nourishes my eye area and smooths lines. Before this jar arrived my rating would be a solid 5. I rate this 1 because the jar is not full. Approximately 1/2 of product is simply not there. There's a bubble or hole where it should be. I've tried to exchange for a full jar multiple times using online chat and customer service calls with no resolution.I cannot get a live person on the phone to explain it.I understand mistakes happen in production. But for EL to make it impossible to resolve is wrong. It's time for me to begin researching a different line who is responsive to its customers.

Super hydrating for the eye area absorbs well, not greasy and works well under make up. I was looking for a day eye cream to use in conjunction with the ANR NIGHT eye cream. This is a great alternative!
I use this product before applying eye makeup, it helps to keep my eye area soft and is smoother. It is easy to apply and nongreasy.
This is the greatest eye firming cream! It instantly brightens and lifts the eye area. Makeup glides on smoothly.
This product is great for the lines under and around your eyes. It makes them disappear!
Love this item. Not too greasy or heavy feeling. Works well under my makeup.

This eye cream made my eyelids crack, red and now stings if anything touches it so I need to wait for it to heal. And my under eye area was extremely dry with pronounced lines and bags. This is weird because the sample size I received for free didn't do this. Sending in for a refund.

avis.titre: Nice day and evening eye cream
avis.texte: I do feel this eye cream has been affective in smoothing and firming the skin around my eyes. When I layer it with other serums it never pills which is a sign of a great quality product.

I like this Power Eye Balm for an alternative to the Advanced Night Repair Eye Cream. Feels very moisturizing and goes on smoothly. I am not sure if crows feet better but definitely no worse. I am 63.
I love this product and no matter what other product I try I always go back to it. It really is moisturizing and helps wrinkles.
This eye balm is actually amazing, i noticed about 2 weeks of using it my discoloration was evening out and lines were softened. I didnt look so exhausted anymore. Overall it's pricey but worth it!!
I definitely will buy this again as I am seeing a noticeable difference. It is not greasy or heavy like most eye creams.

I can't believe how frequently I see air bubbles in recent Estée Lauder products. Is this a systematic issue? I've had air bubbles in Revitalizing Supreme Youth Power crème, eye balm and moisturizer SPF 15. All of them! I took photos from all angles and the bubble looks so big that it's almost 1/5 of the jar.

avis.titre: Re-awakens eye areas natural collagen production
avis.texte: This eye cream helps your eye area repair itself easier by boosting collagen production. Great for people with crepiness around the eye

I've used this eye balm for a while. I like it better than the DayWear eye cream. It seems to moisturize better. We live in Iowa, so the cold winters dry out the skin around my eyes and this does a good job of keeping them moisturized.

avis.titre: Gonna put a ring on it
avis.texte: Whoa. My search for eye cream is over. My first day using it was better than I ever expected.
Love this product my eyes are so comfortable I feel no side effects on my sensitive eyes, love it and my sister is going to purchase for herself as well as we both are a fan.
What a luscious feel to this silky crème. It does what it says. I will be purchasing this again. It absorbs readily with massaging application. A splurge item worth the $$$.

Love the gorgeous creamy texture of this balm. Feels fo hydrating when applied under my eyes. I like the Pro-Aging ingredients and its a great starting point for anyone wanting to get into more advanced skin care routine.
I use this eye cream as mask at night. I love it! It hydrate, and take care of the puffiness and lines and wrinkles..

avis.titre: Best eye cream for crows feet and dark circles
avis.texte: My under eyes are always dry and has some advanced crows feet and i noticed a difference in my overall look. Lines are reduced and i look more rested
It has very nice lotion consistency. Not thick cream. It seems to hydrate, and it seems to help keep wrinkles at bay. I got a sample with purchase of another EL product.

I received a sample of the Revitalizing Supreme Youth Power Eye Balm in a recent GWP, and decided to try it at night since it's thicker and creamier than my usual ANR Supercharged Gel Cream(I love that product for the "Three-Minute Fatigue Fighter" in my morning routine). I like the Youth Power Balm as an eye mask or bedtime treatment...it's smoothing and hydrating. It's a great product which smoothes the area under my eyes.

I received this eye cream as part of a sample pack. It absolutely, does what it professes. I've noticed the fine lines are, far less noticeable. As are the dark circles and puffiness. Needless to say, I've ordered the product in a full sized jar.

I'm in my early 30s and started noticing fine (dehydration) lines around my eyes. I received a sample of this eye cream, not expecting it to make a difference. Boy was I wrong! I've been using it both day/night and the fine lines around my eyes have improved significantly! I have dry, sensitive skin and have not had any issues. I purchased the full size already. Worth the high price for me. Bonus: perfect to use under a hydrating concealer!

I'm in my early 30s and started noticing fine (dehydration) lines around my eyes. I received a sample of this eye cream, not expecting it to make a difference. Boy was I wrong! I've been using it both day/night and the fine lines around my eyes have improved significantly! I have dry, sensitive skin and have not had any issues. I purchased the full size already. Worth the high price for me. Bonus: perfect to use under a hydrating concealer!

I have tried many eye creams and I finally think I have found the perfect one. It is moisturizing, goes on very easy. I wanted something to work on wrinkles and eyelids and I really think I can finally tell a difference using this product. I highly recommend.

The facial moisturizer is quite heavy to the touch, but the real problem is the eye cream, this is nothing like the discontinued TimeZone I was used to using! Please bring it back. I now have small undereye wrinkles where for years I had none with Time Zone.This is just not doing it for me. I'm not happy. Tried to get my department store to sell me any unsold discontinued TimeZone but they refused.
I have used this serum a few years ago and i switched to another brand but it wasn't that good. I started using it again earlier this year and my skin felt great. I am a big fan.

In received this eye cream as a sample and just loved it, therefore, I just bought a full jar of it. This eye creme is smooth, and it does not burn the eyes once applied. I have found that most eye cremes make my eyes burn,but NOT this one! This eye creme is gentle and it helps to remove the fine lines under my eyes. It is also quite soothing. I use it during the day, under my eye primer. Love it very much!

I am very impressed with the texture of this product,the feeling of the product on my under eye is delicate and a little goes a long way. I am simply in love with the results and will definitely be a part of my regimen.

I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I normally prefer thicker creams since my skin is dry, plus I use a high potency retinol, and this moisturizer kept my skin hydrated all day. The scent is very faint. It didn't break me out either.
I blot under my eye and over eye lid, smooths out the area reducing appearance of fine lines.

I got a small bottle sample and been using it for a few weeks and I can see a huge difference in my under eye, makes my face look less tired and don't need to wear make up as much as I used to. Love it and I'm about to order another one!

I just started using it after reading all the good reviews. It hydrates and absorbs well. My eye bag is decreased. I love this product and I will continue to use it. If I notice any other good changes to my eyes, I will make it my permanent eye cream.

avis.titre: Reduced dark circle, puff and lines of my eyes
avis.texte: The best eye cream I have tried. Just 2 days, I can tell my skin of eyes have firmed, the puff, dark circle were gone. plus the lines were reduced. Very happy to have tried and discover this creme. Definitely it will be my eye cream from now!!

avis.titre: Oh my, I love the feel of this eye cream
avis.texte: This eye cream feels so rich and makes my skin so soft. Girls, you have to try this eye cream, really!

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again.
avis.texte: I have been using this eye balm for a week now at night. This is the best product I have used so far. This lightweight balm melts into a silky cleansing oil as you massage over skin leaving my skin so nourished and smooth.

I am 32 yrs. old with combo skin. I have very fine lines starting to develop under my eyes. I used this for 3/4 months and did not see any difference at all. I gave this product 2 stars bc I have sensitive skin, especially under the eyes and this was a great moisturizer. However, I feel like there are better products for a cheaper price, with actual results, out there. Any time I buy skin care I review the products and make sure to research how to properly use. This is not a product that will show any results.
my eyes feel so good as soon as i put it on ! great stuff to bad it's only a sample i have and it's to expensive for me 😩
Very moisturizing for my 42 year old under eyes! Goes great under my concealer
Goes on smooth- it is creamy and thick. My eyes feel better as soon as I put it on.
I really love the eye balm. I use it before bed and it has made a big difference in the fine lines.
Received this as an extra gift with purchase, made my eyes crinkley, and worse before used, puffy as well.

I received this product complimentary through Influenster in exchange for my honest review. And honestly, I love it! It's a thicker, fast absorbing cream without feeling heavy or greasy. I personally like to use it at night. It is sooo hydrating and perfect for winter. I feel it makes my skin feel more firm and it has some great anti-aging ingredients.

First I am 71 with fair, dry skin. My grandmother taught me to take care of my skin from a young age, which I did all my like. Three years ago I discovered Estee skin care and am glad I did. I have faithfully used the Revitalizing Supreme+ product line and love the Youth Power Eye Balm. At my age it is great to have no eye lines or wrinkles. I use it between my brow, which no longer has any lines, and around my lips too. This is a wonderful product line. I recommend it.
